summary: The drift-course blend (Course = Slerp(forward, drifted, amount)) compounded per frame, so a 30 fps device pulled the course onto the nose half as hard as 60 fps during the trigger ramp. It now runs as 60 fps sub-steps (DriftCourseShare); 60 fps is unchanged, lower frame rates now drift like 60. Affects every drifting hull, human and AI, on low-fps devices.
